title: Evidence record
description: The `evidence` payload of an evidence ledger event. `limitations` is required and must be non-empty: every evidence record this project has produced so far has real limits (headless SwiftShader is not a device, a representative slice is not a full run), and a record that omits them reads as a stronger claim than it is.

independence_level.description: A source-blind, B source-restricted, C separate pass in shared context, D prepared but not executed. C and D must never be described as independent.
